notes: Entity alias registry per docs/data-contract.md. Slug aliases resolve duplicate university identities created when later pipeline runs derived a fresh slug from ranking names instead of reusing the original record; the canonical slug is the original record holding the richer source history. Ranking-label aliases map QS 2026 institution names to canonical slugs so ranking joins can be exact instead of fuzzy. Aliases improve recall and identity resolution only; they never create policy facts.
